methods: four-quarter mean; last actual; same-quarter bridge; previous-quarter market; fixed 50/50 mean-bridge blend
unknown_month_rule: Latest three available monthly YoY rates averaged; apply to matching prior-year levels
timing: End-of-day ALFRED vintage events plus P&G publication dates; not an intraday execution record
selection: Retrospective model development; these periods were examined earlier, so not an untouched confirmation sample
